com.vector.cfg.automation.scripting.base

Interface IAutomationContext

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IDynamicObjectAware
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    IApplicationScriptExecutionContext, IAutomationContext.IApplicationAutomationContext, IAutomationContext.IProjectAutomationContext, IProjectScriptExecutionContext, IScriptCreationApi.IScriptExecutionContextWithNotExecutableReasons, IScriptExecutionContext

    @PublishedApi(value=CLASS_DEPENDENCY)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IAutomationContext
extends IDynamicObjectAware
    IAutomationContext class represents the execution context of the automation API, normally a script will use the sub type IScriptExecutionContext. The IAutomationContext provides a base to use automation API with or without scripts and script tasks.

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.

      • getInstance

        @PublishedMethod
<T> T getInstance(java.lang.Class<T> clazz)
        Returns the requested service instance by the passed Class.

        Normally this method is used to retrieve automation API instance from Java code clients, where these instance are not available like in Groovy.

        Type Parameters:
        T - the type of the instance to retrieve
        Parameters:
        type - the class of the requested instance.
        Returns:
        service instance
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - - if the argument is null
        com.google.inject.ConfigurationException - if this IServiceContext cannot find or create the provider.
        com.google.inject.ProvisionException - if there was a runtime failure while providing an instance.

      • getPaths

        @PublishedMethod
IAutomationPathsApi getPaths()
        Returns the paths API to retrieve and resolve Path objects.

        Possible paths are:

        • Script folder
        • Temp folder
        • SIP folder
        • Project folder
        Returns:
        the paths API
        See Also:
